question: Kottakkal Nandakumaran Nair is a Sangeet Natak Akademi 2019 Awardee for his contribution to _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kottakkal Nandakumaran Nair:-**

 
 
• He is a recipient of the Sangeet Natak Akademi award in 2019 for his contribution to Kathakali.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali:-**
 
 
• It is a traditional dance-drama form that originated in the state of Kerala, India. It is characterized by elaborate costumes, facial makeup, and hand gestures.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam:-**

 
 
• It is a classical dance form that originated in the southern state of Tamil Nadu, India. It is characterized by intricate footwork, hand gestures, and facial expressions.
 
 
 
• **Contemporary dance:-**
 
 
• It is a genre of dance that emerged in the mid-20th century and encompasses various styles and techniques.
 
 
 
• **Odissi:-**
 
 
• It is a classical dance form that originated in the eastern state of Odisha, India. It is characterized by fluid movements, intricate footwork, and expressive facial expressions.
